label: D2: reached S1 after the previous trial was rewarded (mostly a2->S1 rare), mid-episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the reached-state input is S1 (100% of mass) and the previous trial was rewarded (100%). 99.7% of activations are a2 -> S1 (rare transition); a handful of a1 -> S1 common steps (9 on dev) carry the very highest activations but negligible mass. Never fires at D1 or GO, on S2, or after an unrewarded previous trial. The base predicate D2 & S1 & a2 & prev_reward==1 has recall 0.999 but precision 0.34; a strong episode-time dependence (fires on trials ~15-70 of the 100-trial episode, essentially never before trial 10 or after 80) lifts precision to 0.56 (dev F1 0.70, mass recall 0.96). Activations also concentrate in a narrow band of value (7.1-7.5) and policy logit (-8.9 to -4.4, i.e. strongly preferring a2), suggesting the unit encodes the surprise of a rare S1 outcome while the agent is committed to a2 and the remaining false positives reflect a slow hidden-state drift rather than a crisp trial variable. All variables are observed at D2; no future variables used.
